notes: Level 1 D-22 is centered in a recessed, deeper stage with two front/rear bearing piers.
Level 2 follows the entrance arc, keeps a standing platform over the stage, and opens to the right-side upper exit.
The stairwell is open through the upper floor, with 15 equal treads and a flush +2.66 m landing.
Section shows exposed steel columns, beams, braces and rods; red timber is fixed-color and lighting remains separate.
Meshy Agent B04 v2 is applied to the four backbar bays; walnut/glass improved, with residual gradient and label text retained for later cleanup.
Lighting pass: three stage spots are now under the standing platform; rays to D-22 and the black-brick recess clear the upper floor, preserving a dark but readable stage.

Upper platform is intentionally empty: continuous floor and stairwell opening remain, with no furniture, wall frames, or extra lights. Two suspended PA assemblies are hidden because they obstructed the upper-gallery edge.
